Answer: D
Reason: The chest radiograph shows right lung volume loss with mediastinal shift to the right and a "kinked" vessel (likely an anomalous pulmonary vein or bronchial artery), which are characteristic findings of right upper lobe hypoplasia. Compensatory hyperaeration of the remaining right lung lobes is typically present in such cases, supporting this diagnosis over agenesis or atelectasis alone.
